_comment: Every process on this machine with its CPU, memory, state and how long it has been running. Reads /proc on Linux and ps on macOS.
_refresh_comment: Seconds between polls. On Linux this is also the window %CPU is measured over, and the header names it every frame.
_show_all_users_comment: Start with every user's processes listed. `u` switches between all users and only yours for the session.
_show_kernel_threads_comment: List kernel threads (pid 2 and its children, Linux only). Hidden ones are counted in the header, never silently missing.
_show_threads_comment: Start with each process's threads listed under it (Linux only). `t` shows or hides them for the session; they are never counted as processes.
